note: Synthetic example. Names and node IDs are illustrative. Times only; no date was given.

messages.author: Anneli Koivisto
messages.text: Tauno, the MW-77 radio link went down for about four minutes, twice this evening. No weather alarms, but an 'input voltage low' power alarm at the same moments. Can you check tomorrow morning?

messages.author: Tauno Hiltunen
messages.text: Sure. Is it the long-haul hop or the access hop?

messages.author: Anneli Koivisto
messages.text: Long-haul hop towards the Salmijärvi tower.

messages.author: Tauno Hiltunen
messages.text: On site. The 48 V PSU output has a ripple on the scope, about 3 volts peak to peak. Looks like it is dying.

messages.author: Olavi Rinne
messages.text: Swap the PSU. But the mains at that site is weak, so keep an eye on it.

messages.author: Tauno Hiltunen
messages.text: PSU swapped. Output is clean and the link is up with good margin.

messages.author: Anneli Koivisto
messages.text: The link is stable from our side, no alarms.

messages.author: Tauno Hiltunen
messages.text: It is minus 12 here, my fingers are frozen. Going to the petrol station for coffee.

messages.author: Olavi Rinne
messages.text: Log the old PSU as faulty please. And do not forget the safety refresher course next week.
